findings.issue: `congr 1; ext r s; by_cases hri ... <;> by_cases hsj ... <;> simp [AlgHom.mapMatrix_apply, Matrix.single_apply, ...]` re-proves entrywise that an algebra hom maps `single i j 1` to itself; Mathlib already has this as a simp lemma.

summary: The coefficient-extension map is defined twice (as an L-linear map and as a ring hom) with a hand-rolled bridging lemma, when Mathlib's Algebra.TensorProduct.map already yields a single L-algebra hom whose toLinearMap is definitionally the linear version; this makes ~50 lines of map_one/map_mul plumbing redundant. Also an undocumented `change`, two rfl-through-coercion steps, and a case bash duplicating `Matrix.map_single`.
